title: Design System: 解语 Jieyu Studio

narrative.overview: Desktop-first field linguistics console: graphite left rail, ink CTAs, neutral selection (no brand accent), compact density, type isolation for IPA.
keyCharacteristics: 52px left rail; no global top nav
Ink CTA + neutral --theme-accent-* selection (no brand violet)
Inter/Noto UI vs Charis SIL IPA

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Only --theme-accent-* for selection/focus/media; neutral charcoal, not brand color.

rules.name: The No Brand Accent Rule
rules.body: No consumer brand purple/blue in chrome; color only in --state-*.

rules.name: The No Global Top Nav Rule
rules.body: Desktop forbids a full-width global top nav; navigation is the 52px left rail.
